{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid neural pacifier''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] utility item that fired a beam capable of disrupting the neural pathways of biological creatures. This resulted in the target being stunned for a short period of time.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
